title: PP_SW_AUDIO=1 seam branch is never compiled by any automated gate
evidence: app/audio/audio.odin:47: `when #config(PP_SW_AUDIO, false) {` (the 16 no-op wrapper branch). tools/ci-local.sh:66 (the only debug-build gate): "PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile gate)|odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin && odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/harness-debug". grep -rn PP_SW_AUDIO over tools/ and .github/ returns zero matches; .github/workflows/ci.yml:126-128 compiles PP_DEBUG only.
detail: The diff adds a whole compile-time branch (16 stub procs) that no gate ever compiles. A signature drift or unwrapped new rl audio call stays green in CI and only fails at the next manual gallery SW build.
recommended_fix: Extend gate 9/ci.yml PP_DEBUG step with a compile leg: `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -define:PP_SW_AUDIO=true` (stock raylib links fine; the stubs just drop raudio references).

title: B1 fail-loud exit path verified end-to-end only for the harness binary, only locally
detail: The B1 refusal (a round-1 blocker fix) is unit-pinned at the data stage, but the exit wiring is exercised E2E only for harness, only on dev machines. The app and palcheck os.exit(2) wrappers are never run by any gate.
recommended_fix: Add tools/font_guard_check.sh to ci.yml after the golden step (it needs only bash + committed assets + bin/harness), and add an app-binary leg asserting exit 2 with fonts absent.

title: NOC mono-pairing wiring unpinned: a draw_mono_c regression passes every automated gate
detail: Acceptance rule 4 (NOC renders in the mono pairing) is enforced nowhere mechanically. Reverting noc_row/noc_col to draw_text_c passes the tabular unit pin, the paint smoke, and all goldens.
recommended_fix: Extend overlay_pixels_check to assert mono metrics on the rendered panel (e.g. sampled digit-column pitch equals font_mono advance), so a font-swap regression in the overlay fails the gate.

title: Contrast acceptance (ink_soft 7.2:1, brightened NOC text) has no ratio pin
evidence: data/palette.json:10: "\"ink_soft\":      [66, 72, 80, 255],". app/render/palette.odin:200: "p.ink_soft = jcol(obj, \"ink_soft\", {66, 72, 80, 255}) // N5: the 08-23 high-contrast fold (4.8:1 -> 7.2:1)". app/render/noc_overlay.odin:318: "NOC_TXT_DIM   :: rl.Color{195, 206, 220, 255} // body numbers (08-23: high-contrast ruling)". grep contrast|luminance over app/render/*_test.odin + palcheck.odin: luminance pins exist only for sprite casing/band tokens, none for text contrast.
detail: The user-ruled high-contrast acceptance is verified only in PR prose. T2 goldens detect ink_soft pixel changes, but a deliberate re-bless has no oracle; NOC colors (debug surface) have no goldens at all.
recommended_fix: Add a palette unit pin: contrast_ratio(canvas, ink_soft) >= 7.0 and a NOC_TXT-vs-plate minimum, per project doctrine that acceptance criteria become durable tests.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (T1/replay byte-identical + T2 spine verified by harness gate; view-only change). P1 ≈88%: body/header/⚠ merge/mono-tabular data/size ladder all FULL (4 font pins + 56-test render suite + goldens); fail-loud E2E ~80% (harness-only, local-only), NOC mono wiring ~60%, contrast ~70%. Overall ≥85%. P1 in 80-89% band.
recommended_fix: Wire font_guard_check.sh + a PP_SW_AUDIO compile leg into ci.yml; add a mono-pairing assertion to overlay_pixels_check and a contrast-ratio palette pin — this lifts P1 ≥90% for PASS.
